paragraphs: ETA sells transit technology to agencies running buses, trains, shuttles, campuses, airports and regional networks.

Its CAD/AVL system is cloud-hosted and built for real-time visibility, dispatch support, reliable data and flexible integrations. Dispatchers work from a real-time board that manages routes, vehicles and schedules in one interface. On the vehicle, operator software covers service assignments, turn-by-turn guidance, pre-trip inspections and two-way messaging. Rider-facing information covers arrivals, alerts, signage, apps and GTFS/GTFS-RT feeds.

The product pages address operations, planning and scheduling, executives, IT, maintenance and safety staff. Under enterprise security the company lists single sign-on, role-based access control and SOC 2 compliance. A customer story on the site describes CAD/AVL modernization and custom radio integration with TARTA.

quote.text: ETA helps agencies see service clearly, respond faster, and deliver more reliable trips for riders.
